item.title: Incarico post-doc: Empirical Software Engineering: quality, evolution, architecture, testing, and performance of software systems (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2027-01-26 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-05 Sistemi di elaborazione delle informazioni

The research activity is situated in the field of empirical software engineering and focuses on the quality, evolution, architecture, testing, and performance of software systems. It aims to investigate how software design and development decisions, as well as source code changes, affect relevant properties of software systems, including quality, maintainability, reliability, performance, and energy efficiency. Activities may include empirical analyses of software repositories and projects, the design and execution of experiments, static and dynamic software analysis, and the development and evaluation of methods and tools supporting the development and evolution of high-quality software…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: A framework for low-resolution data acquisition (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IMIS-01 Misure

This project aims at developing a framework enabling measurements based on quantified signals using few bits or even one-bit. It will address the problem of estimating the parameters of signals, such as amplitude, frequency, time-of-arrival, delays, noise magnitudes, based on their binary version or of a very low-resolution, coarse representation. The central question in this project is how we process low-resolution / one-bit data to provide enough information on the full-resolution signal, after severe quantization.

The research program concerns the development of advanced technologies for high-temperature thermal control in space within the ASI MICONS project. Activities will include the development and use of numerical models, analysis of evaporation, condensation and two-phase flow phenomena, parametric simulations to optimize geometries and operating conditions, comparison with experimental data, and support to prototype design. item.title: Incarico post-doc: CFD analysis of an air system for thermal storage with PCM (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-04 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-01 Sistemi, metodi e tecnologie dell'ingegneria chimica e di processo

The research project focuses on the fluid-dynamic and thermal study and optimization of a Thermal Energy Storage (TES) system based on Phase Change Materials (PCM), using air as the heat transfer fluid. The objective is to develop and validate transient Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulation models to analyze the charging (melting) and discharging (solidification) processes of the PCM. The study will evaluate different heat exchanger geometries and operating air parameters to overcome the low thermal conductivity limitation of PCMs, thereby maximizing heat transfer efficiency.
